{{Quote|Enjoy the bold taste of Socorro's black sands and rugged Killee Wasteland with this well-done slider. We top a blackened patty with four pieces of crispy tailring bacon and the Monnoks' smoky steak sauce.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Socorro slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Tailring bacon''' was a type of [[Bacon/Legends|bacon]] that shared its name<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> with the [[tailring]], a domesticatable animal [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].<ref name="Black Sands of Socorro">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref> The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] used four pieces of tailring bacon in the [[Socorro slider]]s that he sold at his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tailring bacon was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
